about_the_game:
Sneak out. Don’t get caught. Build the perfect office escape.
Now in Early Access

💼 You’ve had enough work for one day…
Your boss doesn’t agree. In Exit Strategy, you’ll need to sneak, sabotage, and slither your way out of the office without getting caught. Avoid the boss. Dodge HR. Distract your coworkers. And for extra credit? Nab your paycheck on the way out.

🎮 Gameplay Highlights

🧠 Solve stealth puzzles with hilarious office obstacles
🥷 Use vents, lockers, coffee overflows, microwave stink clouds, and water spills to your advantage
😈 Evade a reactive boss who learns and adapts to your tricks
📈 Go for optional objectives like grabbing your paycheck to climb the leaderboards
📞 NEW: The boss will now call your cell phone — answer, decline, or silence it before it gives away your position!

🍽️ Co-worker Lunch Drama
Try stealing a Power Bowl or Lasagna from the fridge… then brace for the furious reaction!

🤼‍♂️ Physical Interactions
Push, bump, or knock over coworkers using nearby items — because sometimes stealth needs a little shove.

🎵 Now with new title screen music to kick off your escape in style

🛠️ Build Mode: Create and Share Your Own Escapes

When you're not escaping, you're designing. Jump into Build Mode to craft your own devious office layouts using dozens of props and gameplay objects.

🧱 Place walls, desks, vents, microwaves, paychecks, patrol routes, and more
🧑‍💼 Test co-worker behaviors, hiding spots, and boss patrols
🌐 Share your creations via full Steam Workshop support (Early Access only)

👀 What to Expect in Early Access

This is a solo-dev stealth puzzle game with a growing community. During Early Access, you’ll help shape the future of:

🏢 New office props, tools, and distractions
🔦 Upcoming: Light switches, co-worker room reactions, and larger map options
🤖 Deeper AI and unique co-worker personalities
🎯 New mission types and leaderboard challenges
🧩 Build Mode upgrades and editor features

🎭 For Fans of Stealth & Satire

Inspired by stealth classics and The Office-style absurdity, Exit Strategy is a chaotic blend of puzzles, comedy, and workplace vengeance. If you've ever dreamed of ghosting out at 2:37 PM… this is your game.

🛎️ Join the Community

📣 Share ideas, report bugs, and post your creations
💬 Join the Official Discord

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+ 64-bit (latest version)
  • Processor: 8-core Intel i7/i9 or AMD Ryzen 7/9
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 Super or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Stealth puzzles set in a dangerously relatable office. Sneak past your boss, dodge HR, and escape early—or build your own chaotic office layouts and share them on Steam Workshop. Use distractions, vents, lockers, and pure audacity. Build. Escape. Repeat.
